3845-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3845-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6505-7918.description:
Cast Spore Frog by paying its mana cost.
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2626-3652-4986.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3755-4885-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-4885-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4885-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Pensive Professor with "Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen

4997-7040-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4997-7040-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two cards exiled with it.

1824-4549-6710.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-4549-6710.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1417-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

243-628-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2438-4681-5170-5933.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

147-4050-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-1987-2364-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1274-5070-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5070-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-3180-4053.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-3180-4053.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

252-2073-5256--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2525-4681-5686.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

413-1405-2923.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
413-1405-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
When Scourge of the Throne enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

659-1322-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-1322-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1643-2073-3459-5256.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Clown Car's power.
Repeat.

1283-2254-2825-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
1283-2254-2825-4222.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Songs of the Damned without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

1810-2808.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
1810-2808.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.

678-944-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Blood Vassal dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Vassal by paying {B}.
Repeat.

112-3009-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
112-3009-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Akroan Conscriptor.
Akroan Conscriptor triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target another creature with Clockspinning to get infinite proliferate, or you may use Akroan Conscriptor's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

2060-4120-4629.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vigor indestructible.
You have the highest life total.
2060-4120-4629.description:
Give Vigor indestructible by any method.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature you don't control, Vigor and each player, and putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1496-2816-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Nylea's Disciple with haste.
The token enters gaining you 5 life for each Verdant Sun's Avatar you control, gaining at least 10 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2556-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
